# Ériu Sourcing

> Irish-run China sourcing company serving importers in Ireland, the UK, the EU, the US, Canada, Australia, the UAE and South Africa. Ériu Sourcing helps businesses buy direct from China: supplier verification, price negotiation, pre-shipment quality control, compliance checks and freight. Founded by Noel Murphy, who has lived and worked in China since 2008, with teams in Shenzhen (Guangdong) and Zhengzhou (Henan). Three divisions: China sourcing for Irish and UK businesses; Ériu Phones & Parts, a worldwide wholesale supplier of used and new phones, tablets and phone parts bought in Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei market; and Ériu Modular Homes, expandable steel-frame homes sold FOB China. German-language pages serve buyers in Germany and Austria.

Key facts:
- Company: Ériu Sourcing is a trading name of Springfield Tectop Limited, registered in Ireland, company no. 571256, incorporated 5 November 2015. Registered office (legal address only, not a working office): Clareview Business Center, Ennis Road, Co. Limerick, V94 EA3A, Ireland. The company's offices are on Meiban Road, Longhua District, Shenzhen and Nanyang Road, Huiji District, Zhengzhou, China, with a warehouse in Dongguan. The group has registered companies in mainland China, Hong Kong and Ireland.
- Supply and ship only: Ériu supplies and ships goods from China. It does not install anything.
- China bases: Shenzhen (electronics, phones and phone parts, consumer goods; logistics and fulfilment operation since 2011) and Zhengzhou, Henan (steel, modular buildings, machinery, construction materials).
- Service areas: Ireland, the UK, the EU, the US, Canada, Australia, the UAE and South Africa (general sourcing, with country pages covering local import rules); worldwide (Ériu Phones & Parts); Germany and Austria (German-language pages).
- Contact: +353 87 118 7806 (phone and WhatsApp) · https://eriusourcing.com/contact/

## Ériu Phones & Parts (worldwide wholesale)

Wholesale used iPhones, used Samsung Galaxy phones, refurbished phones, new Android phones (global versions), tablets and iPads, smartwatches and earbuds, plus replacement screens, batteries, small repair parts and accessories, for phone shops, repair businesses and distributors in any country.

Key facts:
- Ériu has its own full-time buyer working the Huaqiangbei electronics market floors in Shenzhen.
- Every used phone is IMEI-checked against blacklist databases and checked for Activation Lock, Google account lock and remote management (MDM); locked or reported phones are rejected. Battery health and parts history are recorded per phone.
- Every replacement screen is powered up and touch-tested; every battery is capacity-tested and date-checked; small parts are tested from every batch.
- The Bench-Proof Guarantee: (1) after the deposit, the buyer sees a test video and test record of their batch before paying the balance; (2) any part that arrives dead or fails the stated test spec, reported with a photo or short video within 14 days, is replaced free on the next order or credited. Parts damaged while being fitted are not covered.
- Wholesale by the batch only, for phone shops, repair businesses and distributors. No single phones or screens, no public stock list and no pre-order videos; quotes are made against the buyer's own list. Mixed orders of phones, parts and accessories ship together.
- Shipping: door-to-door express worldwide (DHL, FedEx, UPS), or FOB China to the buyer's own forwarder for larger orders.
- No copied brand products or copied logos.

## Modular homes (Ireland)

Key facts:
- Supply and ship only, sold FOB China. A deposit confirms the order and starts factory production; the balance is paid when the unit ships from China.
- The 20ft Expandable (about 34 m² internal), the model that fits Ireland's 32–45 m² Class 3A back-garden exemption, is €12,995 FOB China including simple furniture. The 20ft Expandable entry point is €9,990 FOB.
- Freight, Irish import VAT and duty are handled by the buyer's own Irish freight forwarder and customs broker; foundations, craning and service connections are priced by the buyer's own contractor.

- [Ériu Modular Homes](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/): Expandable steel-frame homes for Irish back gardens
- [Back-garden homes and Class 3A](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/back-garden-homes-ireland/): The 32–45 m² planning exemption, its conditions, the rental and tax position, planning versus building regulations
- [Auxiliary dwelling definition](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/auxiliary-dwelling-ireland/): Every Class 3A condition, rental tax, LPT, insurance and mortgage points
- [Building regulations](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/building-regulations-ireland/): Why planning-exempt homes still need full Building Regulations compliance, a Commencement Notice and an NZEB BER
- [Models](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/models/): 20ft, 30ft, 40ft and 20FT700 specifications and floor plans
- [Cost](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/cost/): FOB price tiers and the Irish-side costs your own contractor prices
- [Rental income](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/rental-income-garden-home-ireland/): Long-term letting a garden home, the RTB position and after-tax numbers
- [A home for adult children](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/home-for-adult-children-ireland/)
- [Downsizing and granny flats](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/downsizing-granny-flat-ireland/)
- [Factory visits](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/factory-visits/): Three-day factory visit programme in Zhengzhou and Shenzhen
